theorem_1.name: WALL_Y0_GREEDY_PEEL_V1
theorem_1.statement: For every sealed wall-family instance G_n, with post-seed-two residual Y0=Z_n, G_n is 4-colorable iff G_n-Z_n is 4-colorable; every coloring of G_n-Z_n extending the frozen source colors extends to G_n in O(|Z_n|) time.

proof.forward: Restriction of any proper coloring of G_n to G_n-Z_n is proper.
reverse: Take any proper 4-coloring phi of G_n-Z_n extending the frozen source colors.
For an ordinary z_e, N(z_e)={a,b}, so at most two colors appear on N(z_e); since L(z_e)=[4], choose a color outside phi(N(z_e)).
For the special z*, N(z*)={a*,b*,r}, so at most three colors appear on N(z*); again a color in [4]\phi(N(z*)) exists.
Z_n is stable, so coloring one z_e creates no constraint on any other z_f.
Therefore all z_e can be reinserted independently.
proof.runtime: Every z_e has degree at most 3, so scanning its neighbor colors and choosing the least available color is O(1) per vertex and O(|Z_n|) total.
proof.exactness: No branching, global state, separator, mim-width decomposition, or semijoin is used.

theorem_2.name: WALL_CORE_EXPLICIT_EXTENSION_V1
theorem_2.statement: For every n>=7, the graph G_n-Z_n has an explicit proper coloring extending all frozen source colors.

component_message_analysis.definition: For a residual connected Y0 component C and forbidden-color mask F subseteq [4] induced by complete outside neighbors, mu_C(F)=1 iff C can be properly colored subject to every color in F being unavailable throughout C, with frozen internal/source constraints retained.

wall_ordinary.reachable: |F|<=2 because z_e has only its two wall-survivor complete neighbors

wall_special.reachable: |F|<=3 because z* has wall endpoints plus r

component_message_analysis.joint_consequence: Every residual wall-component message is tautological on every coloring state reachable from the core. Hence the wall incidence pattern contributes zero nontrivial semantic coupling among survivor color decisions.

algorithmic_interpretation.structural_width: mimw(I_sigma)>=sqrt(n)/50 is unbounded by the sealed wall theorem.
algorithmic_interpretation.semantic_interface: The entire residual Y0 interface peels locally with O(1) information per component and no cross-component coupling.

relation_to_old_router_stack.FACTORIZED_FEEDBACK: NOT_NEEDED_FOR_WALL; Z_n components disappear by local peel.
relation_to_old_router_stack.CUT_SUPPORT_OR_SEMIJOIN: NOT_NEEDED; every wall component has full reachable support.
relation_to_old_router_stack.firewall: No existing carrier scope is reinterpreted or promoted; WALL_Y0_GREEDY_PEEL_V1 is a new source-specific local rule preceding the old stack.

proposed_router_update: FIRST: LOCAL_FULL_LIST_EXTENSION_PEEL on any component whose extension is certified for every reachable outside-color mask.
IF peel does not apply: route to existing exact carrier stack under its frozen preconditions.
